section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study, referred to as 'Study X', which investigated the conceptual equivalence of a Chinese (Cantonese) translation of the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2). The study involved 457 women and 417 men from a university in Hong Kong. Findings indicated a one-dimensional structure for the Chinese BAS-2, good internal consistency, and significant associations with BMI, self-esteem, and life satisfaction.
